Meet your points of contact

CONNECT WITH OUR COORDINATORS.

Chris and Erin both work out of Camp Dodge and team up on statewide programming. Reach out and we’ll cover your regional needs or loop in partners who can help.

Chris Cox

Lead Child & Youth Program Coordinator

JTSI Contractor

Chris Cox leads the Iowa Army National Guard Child & Youth Program. A proud Guard kid himself, he’s passionate about cheering on today’s Guard youth and ensuring every family feels supported, connected, and seen. Alongside Erin, he plans statewide programs that strengthen readiness and resilience across Iowa’s military community.

christopher.j.cox18.ctr@army.mil 515-727-3064

Erin Coogler

Child & Youth Program Coordinator

JTSI Contractor

Erin Coogler helps lead the Iowa Army National Guard Child & Youth Program with heart and purpose. She’s known for her creativity, organization, and deep care for military-connected families. Partnering with Chris, she plans events and initiatives that build connection, confidence, and community for Guard youth across Iowa.

iaarngcyp@gmail.com 515-252-4050
